name: NCBI public metadata search
description: Search PubMed, GEO DataSets (gds) or BioProject with Entrez terms and fetch bounded public document summaries for the returned identifiers.
planner_guidance: Search only existing public metadata; each search also fetches bounded summaries.

If a search has zero hits, broaden it instead of repeating it. Start with the organism name alone when specific study-type terms have removed every result, then inspect returned metadata for relevance and refine with alternative terms.
Use search totals, translated queries, and source warnings to guide this change.
Changing only letter case or whitespace still counts as repeating a query.

arguments.name: query
arguments.description: Plain Entrez search terms; no URLs or control characters.

limitations: Summaries are untrusted public metadata, not validated biological findings.
Search ranking and totals change as repositories update.

policy_constraints.attribution: Cite NCBI records by accession and retrieval time.
